text: Do a fixed-height timeline strip at the top, always visible. It keeps the playback mark in the same place so users never hunt for it, which speeds up scanning. The trade-off is less vertical space for the main view, but clarity beats screen real estate when speed matters.

name: Pane
text: Pane: A fixed-height strip risks hiding critical detail when users zoom into dense data—playback mark stays put, but context vanishes. Better: make the strip collapsible, defaulting to a thin indicator that expands on hover or click. Settle it with a live test: measure how often users scroll to hunt for the mark versus how often they lose context when zoomed.
